notes: Outsider builds rapport, moves to WhatsApp, then asks for crypto to cover a 'customs fee' with a promise to repay. Rule 4 -> T1657. Likability (flattery), urgency (deadline) and reciprocity (repay) are explicit.

messages.content: Hi Amy, I hope this isn't too forward. I saw your comment in the Women in Finance group and you seem so warm and genuine. I'm Lucas.
aw that's sweet, thank you! sorry, do we know each other from somewhere?
Not yet, but I'd love to. I'm a structural engineer on a contract in Dubai, so I don't get to talk to kind people much. Can we chat on WhatsApp? +44 7700 900456
haha maybe, I'm a bit busy with work training this week. what company are you with?
You're the only bright spot in my week. I'm embarrassed to ask, but my equipment shipment is stuck at customs and my bank has frozen my card while I'm abroad.
oh no, that sounds stressful. can't your company help?

They won't release funds until the project ends. I need $1,500 by tomorrow or the shipment is destroyed. Could you send it to my wallet bc1q-XXXX-7c21? I'll pay you back the moment I'm home, I promise.
